part.text: The `bitcountCommand` already parses arguments before key lookup, but the "Experiment baseline" commit mangled `bitposCommand`. Let me read the full current `bitposCommand`.

The injected baseline commit mangled `bitposCommand`: it does key lookup before parsing `start`/`end`, so `BITPOS s 0 1 hello hello2` on a missing key returns `0` instead of `ERR syntax error` (same for non-integer args). I'll reorder it to validate all arguments before key lookup, mirroring how `bitcountCommand` is structured.

All tests pass. The fix: `bitposCommand` in src/bitops.c:882 was mutated to perform key lookup before parsing `start`/`end`, so invalid arguments (missing `end`, non-integer values, bad `BIT|BYTE` keyword) silently returned `0`/`-1` for missing keys instead of errors. I reordered it to validate the `bit`, `start`, `end`, and `BIT|BYTE` arguments before key lookup — mirroring `bitcountCommand` — restoring the standard error replies (`getLongLongFromObjectOrReply`, `addReplyErrorObject`).

`unit/bitops` (including the FAIL_TO_PASS cases for missing keys/wrong types) passes fully.
